page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single main column; a narrow sliver of the facing page at the right edge (partial marginal text of the neighbouring page, not transcribed as it belongs to another page). Running head at top: "De sacris scripturis." left and "Lib. 7." right; page number "260" above the head. Scholastic marginal-style brace annotations ("Luc.24.", "44.", "Act.1.10.") sit beside the text inside the column block.

main_text.p: reducibus: bona omnia, lætitiam obolito stato ieiu-nio promittit: malis vero & hostibus ecclesiæ sub-uersionem denúciat, tum Christi temporibus, ipsius aduentum euidentiss. sig. prædicit, ipsoque sub-lato Iudæ subuersionem, hostium ecclesiæ inter-necionem pronúciat, & ecclesiæ ex electis Iudæis & gentibus conuocatæ glorisam administrationem promittit.

Maleachi vltimi Prophetæ prophetia, est quæ exposito beneficio electionis collato in posteros Ia-cobi, & reprobatione Hhefauui, Iudæos omnes præ-cipuè sacerdotes ob pollutum cultum, neglectum sacerdotis officium, connubia cum infidelibus po-lygamian, diuortiorumq; licentiam, impietatem, iniustitiam, blasphemiam coarguens; abiectionem sa-cerdotij, temporarias & æternas pœnas denunciās, gentium vocationem Iohannis Babtistæ præcursoris Christi, Christiq, aduentum cum suis benedictio-nibus, bonis ad illud tempus in lege acquiscentibus promittit.
Dogma- Psalmi: Luc.24. tici sunt Oratione soluta scripti. 44.

Psalmi, sunt dogmatici, qui documenta voluntatis Dei, ex lege & Prophetis, omnia numerosa & breui ad memoriam figurata, ad vim & efficacitatem complectuntur, vt cum gratia in corde psallant domino. Col.3.16. Eph.4.32.
Sunt Liber Psalmorum. autem Cantica canticorum. Act.1.10.
Liber Psalmorum cuiusq; speciei sacras canti-ones

page.notes: Marginal brace references are printed beside the text ("Luc.24.", "44.", "Act.1.10."); the sliver of the facing page at the right edge is not transcribed. The final word "ones" is partly cut off at the foot and is read as "ones" (possibly "ones" for "ones"); the bottom line is damaged. Several words in the lower lines are partially obscured by the gutter shadow and may be inexact.
